### Israel Obeys the Covenant
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/israel-obeys-the-covenant
Passage: Joshua 5:1-12
Points:
- Facing powerful enemies after Moses' death, Israel needed reassurance of God's continuing presence and favor.
- God confirmed His faithfulness by parting the Jordan and calling Israel to observe the Passover at Gilgal.
- Circumcising the uncircumcised wilderness generation renewed their covenant allegiance before taking the land.
- Outward ritual alone cannot save, but genuine saving faith always demonstrates itself through obedience to God.

### Bible Pathways 03/14/05
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-03-or-14-or-05-1315803.html
Passage: Joshua 5:2-5
Points:
- Receiving the fulfillment of God's promises requires personal obedience and responsibility from His people.
- Administering circumcision restored the covenant sign to the new generation before entering the land.
- Reinstating the covenant sign qualified Israel to celebrate Passover and commemorate God's redemption.
- Ancient circumcision and the Passover foreshadowed the spiritual circumcision of the heart and the work of Christ.
